Quick post-match thoughts:
- Early aggression was good, but we likely should have healed one turn earlier when at 40 HP on Turn 10 to avoid getting into the forced lethal sequence. Once potions are gone, you need a clear damage lead; otherwise, stabilize earlier.
- Against multiple opponent potions, keep pressure but plan potion timing around staying out of 2-turn lethal (typically heal at 40 or below, sometimes at 50 if behind on tempo).
